test_delayed_reward_wrapper_noop: test the DelayedRewardWrapper with accumulation_period=1 to verify it does not change rewards
test_delayed_reward_composite_reward: test the DelayedRewardWrapper with composite multi-dimensional rewards to verify no-op behavior
test_delayed_reward_total_reward_preserv: test the DelayedRewardWrapper with accumulation_period=10 or None to verify total episode reward is preserved
run_episode_reward_collection: run an episode on a dm_env environment and collect all timestep rewards into a list
compare_nested_reward_sequences: compare two sequences of numpy arrays element-wise to verify they are equal
